name: Section on Dövevägen near Vittskövle
description: A random 2 km of Dövevägen, an unnumbered road east of Vittskövle. OSM: its west end is 1.7 km from the village Vittskövle (nothing nearer), its east end 1.2 km from the hamlet Nyehusen och Furuboda, within a hamlet's 1.5 km reach and nearer than any village.
